It’s the Pidgey! They’ve flown the coop!
For years, Trainers like yourself have been sending me Pidgey to research.
I’ve kept each and every one safe and healthy, feeding them the best Berries, providing them with the softest nests...
But somehow they’ve escaped from my lab! Maybe this is what I get for using a Great Fence instead of an Ultra Fence.
*sigh* And after all the care I put into everyone’s Pidgey, too. We’ve got a real whirlwind of a situation on our hands!
On the bright side, this might make for a fascinating paper on the impact of the flighty flock on the local environment...
But first things first. Help me catch as many of these plucky Pidgey as you can, %PLAYERNAME%! Before they try to fly off with my whole trailer...or me!
Phew! I was worried the Pidgey might’ve blown you away.
Most of the Pidgey are back safe in the lab, thanks to you and your fellow Trainers! I’m so glad it wasn’t a gust—er, bust.
Take these items for your help with today’s feathery fracas, %PLAYERNAME%.
I’ve put in an order for double the Pidgey’s usual amount of Berries, so let's hope they’ll feel pampered enough not to be a flight risk anymore.
That’s enough fun for one day, I’d say. Until next time!
%PLAYERNAME%! It is fortunate you are here. Alarming events have transpired.
As I was observing a slow, pink Pokémon, its tail suddenly fell off. I stooped down to pick up the tail, only to discover that the field was covered in more of these detached appendages.
The Pokémon in question did not seem perturbed. However, I am. Could a disease be ailing the Pokémon? Are the fallen extremities separate life-forms?
Please assist me in assessing the situation, %PLAYERNAME%.
Hey, %PLAYERNAME%! I saw you and Rhi running around earlier. What’ve you been up to?
There were Pokémon with their tails falling off? That does sound concerning, but I’ve got a hunch there’s nothing to worry about. Let me have a look!

Hmm... Yep! You’ll both be relieved to know these are just Slowpoke tails. Their tails fall off naturally. The Slowpoke don’t feel any pain when it happens, and their tails grow back, so they aren’t particularly bothered.
Speaking of their tails, did you know that because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor?
So I hear, at least—I’ve never tasted one myself. Ooh, maybe we should have a picnic sometime!
Ahem. Lunch plans aside, I’ll let Rhi know that there’s no cause for concern. Spend more time with the Slowpoke till I’m back, %PLAYERNAME%!
Welcome back, %PLAYERNAME%. Whoa! Not only have you spent more time with Slowpoke, but you’ve helped some evolve, too!
Slowpoke’s pretty special. Not only can it evolve into one of two different Pokémon—Slowbro and Slowking—but each of its Evolutions has regional variants, too.
Slowpoke become Water- and Psychic-type Slowbro when Shellder latch on to their tails. Though usually dim-witted, they seem to become inspired if those Shellder bite down.
Galarian Slowbro, unlike their non-Galarian counterparts, are Poison types.
When a Shellder bites one of them, it sets off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro’s body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon. Pretty wild, huh?
Evolve a couple more Slowpoke, and I’ll have some fun facts about Slowking to share when you’re back!
Back so soon, %PLAYERNAME%? You’re faster than a Slowpoke, that’s for sure! Now for those Slowking facts I promised you.
Slowking undertake research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. They have incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, they remain calm and collected.
Galarian Slowking, on the other hand, have something of a spooky bent. While chanting strange spells, these Pokémon combine their internal toxins with what they’ve eaten, creating strange potions.
What do you think would happen if I drank one of those potions? Maybe I’d turn into a Slowking myself. Who knows what I could accomplish with their level of intellect!
Ah... You’re right, it might be hard for me to communicate like that. Either way, there’s no end to the discoveries we can make about Pokémon together—even if my noggin remains Shellder-free! Haha.
The curiosity of friends like you and Rhi will take us far. I hope you two learned something today. Until next time, %PLAYERNAME%!

I was just settling in to read the latest edition of Pokémon Researcher’s Weekly when I saw a couple of Team GO Rocket Grunts run by.
We should go after them before they get up to anything too dastardly.
*sigh* It looks like my reading will have to wait. I’ll head this way, and you go that way!
Phew! That was a bit of a workout, eh, %PLAYERNAME%?
But I’ll bet you took on that Grunt without breaking a sweat!
And, as usual, I’ll bet they abandoned some poor Pokémon in their wake...
How sad. The least we can do is purify some of these Pokémon.
They’ll have a much happier future with you, %PLAYERNAME%.
They’re looking so cheerful—I’m sure they see you as their hero!
I know I do, but we can’t rest just yet. We need to stop Team GO Rocket at their source—the Leaders.
Let’s get cracking on tracking down those nefarious nuisances!
You made short work of those Team GO Rocket Leaders.
That’s no easy feat. Well, maybe it is for someone like you!
If only they could change their ways permanently... But until they do, we’ll be around to prevent them from doing anything too troublesome.
And that means showing their boss who’s boss.
Challenge the Team GO Rocket Boss Giovanni, %PLAYERNAME%!
Back so soon, %PLAYERNAME%? You’re really not giving Team GO Rocket any time to rest!
And that’s just the way it should be—all in the name of keeping Pokémon everywhere safe.
Thanks for your help, %PLAYERNAME%. Until the next time we need to foil their plans!
Things are pretty calm right now, aren’t they? The Pidove are chirping, the Hoppip are floating...
It makes me want to take a big stretch and go on a nice walk.
You’ve got to savor peaceful days like these, especially considering that Pokémon research can be fraught with all sorts of mystery and danger! Just, well, not today.
But no matter the circumstances, I know you’re looking out for Pokémon everywhere—and for me! In fact, I’ve always thought of you as my hero when I’m in a pinch.
On a relaxing day like this, you deserve a change of pace from our grand adventures. It’s a perfect time to take a look at what’s going on in our own backyard.
Could you check out the Pokémon in the area for me, %PLAYERNAME%?
Welcome back, %PLAYERNAME%! Let’s look at those Pokémon...
You’ve already powered some of them up, I see. Staying prepared in case any dangers arise? Great work, as usual!
With Trainers like you around, even forces like Team GO Rocket can be defeated. Speaking of which, something seems especially sinister about them lately. Just my Pokémon Professor’s intuition.
Hmm. Well, I’ll keep noodling on that. Could be my intuition is oversensitive lately. Let’s just enjoy this peace while we can!
I’m going to review some of my older observations. Why don’t you leave some of those Pokémon with me and see what other Pokémon pals are around?
Thank goodness, %PLAYERNAME%! You came back just in time! You and your new Pokémon are urgently needed!
...I’ve just set up lunch plans with an old friend that I can’t miss.
Haha, sorry for winding you up there! I know you’d never miss a chance to jump in and save the day.
I’ve got a feeling my friend will have some valuable insight into my observations, so I need to collect my notes. I’ll tell you all about our discussion when I get back.
Actually, I could use your help with something—while I look for those notes, could you keep an eye on the team leaders in case they need anything? I bet they could use a hero of their own!
I’m sure you’ll hear from them soon, %PLAYERNAME%. Until then, let’s...hope I can find my notes!
Hey there, %PLAYERNAME%! I don’t have anything juicy for you right now. Have you checked in on the team leaders lately?
